question: How valuable is the Kaula teaching compared to possessing an ocean filled with jewels?
premises: One might possess an ocean filled with jewels
This is set up as a comparison
inference: Even the wealth of a jewel-filled ocean is being compared to this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and difficult form; parsing is tentative
plain_english: Even if one had the accumulation to make the ocean filled with jewels.
